feeds.title: Men's Health Magazine
feeds.description: Men's Health is your ultimate guide to all things fitness, sex, weight loss, nutrition and style. Men's Health is a magazine dedicated to every health concern of Australian men. The health magaizne is manged by Paragon Media, a Sydney-based special interest magazine publishing house.

feeds.title: Australian Men's Health Forum News
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the latest news on the social factors that shape men and boys' health. AMHF is the peak body for men's health in Australia, dedicated to improving the life and health of men and boys.

feeds.title: Men's Health Queensland Blog
feeds.description: Read our Blog dedicated to common men's health disorders including erectile dysfunction, prostate cancer & male pattern baldness. MensHealth-QLD.com.au is your online resource dedicated to providing you with information related to common male health disorders in Queensland, Australia. Information supplied by Dr Clem Bonney.

feeds.title: Stagger Blog
feeds.description: Take a look at the latest news, tips and guides from Stagger! Stagger provides men with fast, convenient and discreet access to treatments and prescriptions through innovative online solutions. We're here to improve people's lives by providing easy, fast, and convenient access to doctors and treatments through digital healthcare platforms.

feeds.title: Freemasons Centre for Male Health & Wellbeing News
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates on men's health research done by the organization. An alliance of organisations across SA & NT that collaborate and invest in research to inform policy and advance the health and wellbeing of males.

feeds.title: Pilot's Health Hub
feeds.description: Level up your learning with actionable articles on men's health. Start learning today with Pilot. Learn more about how modern medicine, science, and a team of trusted clinicians can help you level up your health. Pilot has been able to design safe and effective treatment protocols for erectile dysfunction, hair loss, weight loss and much more.

feeds.title: Clinic 66 » Men's Health
feeds.description: Sex & the reproductive system is a very natural part of being human, it is an essential element of good health. But our culture has labelled it dirty and a taboo subject. Our blog aims to break down these barriers and our articles cover the tough topics that we generally avoid. Clinic 66 is a unique 'one-stop' sexual health clinic in Sydney, Australia and also providing online telehealth consultations for many of our services. We are a procedural medical practice, specialising in reproductive and sexual health diagnosis, prevention, treatment and day surgery procedures for both women and men.
